If you’re looking for a special place to build or grow your career, you’ve found it. Whether you’re an experienced professional, a recent college graduate or somewhere in between, IDEX is a place where you can apply your existing skills and learn new ones in an environment where you can make an impact.

With interesting opportunities in engineering, marketing, sales, supply chain, operations, HR, finance, and more across more than 40 diverse businesses (https://www.idexcorp.com/our-businesses/business-segments/) around the globe, chances are, we have something special for you.

JOB TITLE:
Finance Data & Transformation Analyst

REPORTING TO:
Finance Manager, IH&S

LOCATION:
Remote

Who is IDEX Health & Science (IH&S)?

As a business unit of IDEX Corporation, IH&S has a long history of driving growth in life sciences and healthcare by embracing innovation and redefining the supplier-customer relationship. The work we do every day allows us to discover key insights and break new ground to create some of the most meaningful technologies that have a lasting impact on companies, industries, and society. One of business segments is called Life Science Fluidics and we are looking to add more talent to the team.

IDEX Health & Science (IH&S)

IH&S is comprised of six domestic and one international business unit. IH&S is a manufacturing and R&D focused team that sits at the leading edge of high-end fluidic and optical applications for life sciences. Focused on assisting partners at every stage of the development processes, we invest in people and infrastructure to drive bold ideas and pragmatic solutions. With the rich foundation of talent, universities, and supporting businesses, IH&S is the ideal location to elevate your career with fascinating work and endless opportunities.

Our formula for success is simple. We work hard to maintain a culture where you can own your work; you are encouraged to try new ideas in a collaborative environment; and you can apply your skillset to enable our clients to gain a competitive advantage in their own market. At IDEX Health & Science, you will have the opportunity to work with a great group of people, mentor others, and build a great future.

Scope Of Role

This position plays a critical role in advancing IH&S’s finance data transformation initiatives by focusing on developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards, enabling standardized financial reporting, and translating complex financial and operational data into clear, decision-ready insights. In addition to supporting ongoing reporting needs, this individual will contribute to the design and implementation of scalable data models that support forecasting, KPI tracking, and executive-level performance visibility. Working within an Agile framework, this role will prioritize enhancements and ensure delivery of high-impact analytics solutions that support business performance and strategic decision-making.

Building data models and creating processes for monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting cycles, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and timeliness of data
Analyze financial and operational data to identify ways to capture and report on trends, variances, risks, and opportunities, and present findings to finance leadership
Partner with Finance, Accounting, Commercial, IT, and Operations teams to ensure data consistency, and alignment between the tools (dashboards/reports) used for financial reporting and to monitor business performance drivers
Maintain and prioritize reporting and analytics backlogs leveraging the Agile framework.
Support executive-level reporting by creating clear, concise, and visually compelling dashboards and summaries.
Contribute to finance and business transformation initiatives, including automation of reporting processes and improvement of data accessibility and usability
Support various workflows by developing financial KPI calculation logic, creating PBI visuals for leadership consumption.
Support standardized reporting frameworks and ongoing transformation initiatives related to forecasting, reporting standardization, and data governance

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field, with an emphasis in quantitative methods, statistical modeling, and data science.
3+ years of experience in financial analysis, business intelligence, or data analytics roles in a manufacturing financial environment.
Strong understanding of and experience with financial accounting concepts including financial reporting, cost accounting, FP&A. and KPI development
Understanding of ERP software is required, proficiency in JD Edwards is preferred.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodology is preferred. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum outside of traditional software design is ideal.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into effective technical solutions.
Strong proficiency in Power BI, including DAX and data modeling.
Attention to detail, with consistent application of audit trails, versioning, and documented best practices.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to interact effectively with all levels of the organization.
